p01.why: A handler parameter must not use auto.

p02.why: A handler parameter must not have a qualified name such as n::x.

p03.why: A handler parameter must not have the type void.

p04.why: A return statement is not valid in a handler of a constructor's function try block.

p05.why: The outermost block of the handler declares the parameter v again.

p06.why: The goto transfers control into the try block from outside it.

p07.why: inside is declared in the try block, so the handler cannot see it.

p08.why: The case label transfers control from the switch into the handler.

p09.why: A handler parameter must not have a storage class such as static.

p10.why: A handler parameter must not be a pointer to an incomplete class, and I is incomplete.

p11.why: inside is declared in the try block, so it is not visible after the try block.

p12.why: A handler parameter must not have an rvalue reference type.

p13.why: A handler parameter must not be an abstract class by value.

p14.why: The handler parameter v is visible only in its handler, and the program uses v after the try block.

p15.why: The goto transfers control into the handler from outside it.

p16.why: A handler parameter must not be a reference to an array of unknown bound.

p17.why: The catch-all handler must be the last handler, and here catch (int) follows it.

p18.why: A handler parameter must not be an incomplete class by value.

p19.why: A try block must have at least one handler.
